handbookNote: North Dakota Century Code (N.D.C.C.) Title 43, Chapter 43-23, "State Real Estate Commission" (Sections 43-23-01 through 43-23-24), together with the implementing rules of the North Dakota Real Estate Commission at North Dakota Administrative Code (N.D.A.C.) Title 70, Article 70-01 "General Administration" (Chapters 70-01-01 and 70-01-02) and Article 70-02 "Real Estate Licensure" (Chapters 70-02-01 through 70-02-05); plus N.D.C.C. Chapter 47-10, "Real Property Transfers," Sections 47-10-01 through 47-10-02.3 (seller property-condition, radon, and HOA/condominium disclosure requirements cross-referenced by N.D.C.C. 43-23-11.1); plus N.D.C.C. Chapter 43-23.2, "Real Estate Education Fund" (Sections 43-23.2-01 through 43-23.2-13), North Dakota's real estate education, research, and recovery fund -- price set to $29.99 per user instruction (2026-08-13), applies to all Real Estate tracks not yet loaded into D1
